description: Reads up to sixteen points as a wave, giving a smooth spline through them, the straight lines between them and the bare steps

params.text: Sets the pitch, -14 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 0.016Hz to 4186Hz

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
The points the wave is drawn through, one point per channel, up to sixteen; two points at least are read whatever is patched
A trigger here puts the phase back to the start of the cycle
Drives the wave from an outside phase over -5V to 5V; while a cable is patched here the pitch knob and the V/Oct jack are passed over

outputs.text: A smooth cubic spline drawn through the points
The straight lines from each point to the next
The bare points held one after another, a stepped wave

notes: nothing is heard until points are patched into Pts; with that jack empty the wave is flat
menu: Block DC — takes the constant offset out of the Spl output, which points that are not centred leave behind

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads a flat wave.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
